en.description:
Run the rail yard. Dodge the trains. Beat your best.

Railyard Run is a bright, fast 3D endless runner made for iPhone AND Apple Watch. Swipe to switch tracks, jump barriers, roll under gates and leap onto train roofs while the yard speeds up around you.

PLAY IT ON YOUR WRIST
The full 3D game runs right on Apple Watch. Same world, same power-ups, built for a quick run anywhere. No phone, no Wi-Fi needed.

MADE FOR iPhone Duo
Unfold it for a wide, full-screen rail yard and play it any way you turn it. Fold it mid-run and keep going on the cover screen, right where you left off.

POWER-UPS
• Jetpack: soar above the trains and grab the sky coin trail
• Coin Magnet: pull in every coin nearby
• Spring Shoes: bounce straight onto train roofs
• 2× Score: double every point

HOVERBOARDS AND EXTRA LIVES
Double-tap for a hoverboard that takes a crash for you. Crashed anyway? Spend a heart and keep running.

SOMETHING NEW EVERY DAY
• Daily rewards: a 7-day streak that ends in a Super Chest
• 3 daily missions with coin and XP rewards
• Goals that raise your score multiplier all the way to ×30
• The Rail Pass: 30 tiers of rewards to unlock as you play

MAKE IT YOURS
Upgrade every power-up and unlock outfits for your runner.

CHALLENGE YOUR FRIENDS
Climb the Game Center leaderboards, all-time and weekly, and earn achievements.

FAIR AND FRIENDLY
No ads. No energy timers. Everything that affects a run can be earned just by playing. Optional purchases add coins, cosmetics and the Rail Pass gold track.
en.subtitle: Endless runner for your watch
